name: comp-254

frames.best_why: Reset tooltip is open above the undo arrow while the slider sits at 2 and the value field shows 2.

tagline: Drag the bar or type a number; an undo arrow returns it to default.
summary: A temperature setting that pairs a horizontal slider with a small editable number field. A reset arrow appears once the value changes and reveals a tooltip when hovered.
appearance: The word Temperature sits on the left, followed by a circular arrow icon and a compact rounded box holding a decimal number. Beneath is a grey track with a white filled length and a round white knob.
behaviour: Moving the knob updates the field and typing in the field moves the knob. After any change an undo arrow fades in beside the field; hovering it shows Reset to default, and clicking it snaps everything back and the arrow fades out.
demo_content: Label "Temperature"; the value starts at 1.25, climbs to 2 and resets to 1 on a 0 to 2 scale.
search_phrases: slider with a typed value beside it
reset a setting back to its default
adjust temperature in a home app
decimal value picker between zero and two
track with an input box and undo arrow
control that combines dragging and typing
hover tooltip on a small round button
number field synced to a range bar
use_when: A value needs quick dragging and an exact typed figure, with a one-click way back to its default.
avoid_when: The scale is fixed at 0 to 2 for thermostat-style values; another range means editing the source.
customise: The label, minimum, maximum, starting value and default are set in the source; the tooltip wording and decimal step also need edits.
weight_why: One slider, one input and a button; only opacity and position shift.

a11y.note: Slider, field and reset button all have names, but the invisible reset button stays in the tab order.

issues: The reset button is only faded to zero opacity and remains focusable when it appears hidden.
polish_why: Tight, coherent spacing and a thoughtful reset affordance; small controls but usable.
